verdicts.line: # P02 re-check: no picture, the hall only routes (craft/media.md, C1265).
verdicts.why: the hall has no image of its own; its six cards carry the six rooms' own place pictures, which C1265 now says are not a spot of this kind (a place's image renders only as its card on the menu it is entered from (v2.py:24764); media.md step 2 says that card is the place's one picture, not a door or menu spot)

verdicts.line: (door cards and "Leave <room>": no entry_costs on any home room)
verdicts.why: no location in the game has entry_costs, so the travel charge (setup.travelMoveSlug, v2.py:20490-20512) is never emitted; every hop inside Home costs 0 both ways, as C920 now asks

verdicts.line: (home, home_hall and the six rooms: no costs; Exit Home to Your Street: no costs)
verdicts.why: rule 2: a hop inside an area costs nothing; room-to-room and the front door to her own street (next door) are free in both directions

verdicts.line: image_search_queries = ["woman of 18 eating toast at a small family kitchen counter", ...]
verdicts.why: each of the six rooms has one tier-0 file with her in it (every query names a woman of 18 or a young woman); none is the empty room; the hall has none
step 2 now says a place's card picture is not a door or menu spot under C1265; the hall itself carries no picture
